title: Critique: affect may become conscious only through cortical re-representation

statements.text: Cortical processes could mediate the conscious affect evoked by brainstem stimulation, affective displays could occur without consciousness, and feeling may involve proprioceptive and exteroceptive cortical dynamics. So affective consciousness may require cortical re-representation, not brainstem activity alone.

sources.quote: IWMT suggests affective consciousness may require cortical rerepresentation
Cortical processes could mediate conscious-affect-generation from brainstem stimulation
